summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture and one parametrized test covering all valid forms and every invalid branch. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass together (40 passed) under the prepared venv Python. Black, ruff, isort and mypy are not installed in that venv, so formatting was checked by hand (no lines over 88 columns) and no type check was run. Non-node inputs (None, plain string) were checked manually and raise SHACLPathError. No commits were made and no other files were changed.
